lua.library_policy: Original sandbox: no io/os/package/require/debug/loadfile/dofile/module/native reach; text loadstring and pcall/xpcall supported. Parent process deadlines also cover swallowed instruction-hook errors.
lua.unwired_gameplay: Mail, local trade-session adapters, guilds, party/raid, auctions, auras, taxis, trainer/pet/stable and other original host systems still require real GG gameplay mappings. All ordinary queues are accounted for: unimplemented queues report failure and are drained rather than replayed. An error/drain is not implementation. Local banking/vendor/quest/crafting/loot, action slots, macros, targeting/follow/posture and client preferences are connected within their documented GG policies.
